verdict.line: You lose fights where you commit your full Q-into-W combo into an available Counter Strike, and you win by pulling with E first and punishing Jax's Leap Strike cooldown windows.

brief.thesis: Jax's Counter Strike (E) is the single ability that explains this matchup: it punishes any commitment to Darius's Q-auto into W-auto combo, which is why Jax holds both the lane and solo-kill edge (49.6% Darius win rate over 803 games) despite the overall shape being even. Darius doesn't lose to raw stats here, he loses to the order he trades in. Sequence E (Apprehend) first and hunt Jax's Leap Strike cooldown windows, and the matchup settles back to its even baseline.

theirWindow.when: Jax's E is up, you engage
theirWindow.what: He dodges your auto-reset burst and turns the stun into free Leap Strike autos plus an Empowered Strike proc. Don't commit W's crippling auto until you've either baited the dodge with a single hit or confirmed E is down.

yourWindow.when: Jax's E and Q are both down
yourWindow.what: This is right after he's leapt to a minion or ward to disengage, or already burned Counter Strike. Walk up, land E to guarantee the auto, then Q into W for a full Hemorrhage stack trade he can't punish.

start.why: Doran's Blade is the popular pick (47.4% WR, 74.5% pick over 739 games), but Doran's Shield runs a notably higher 55.8% WR over 163 games. The passive regen and reduced poke matter more here since Jax holds the solo-kill edge and wants to win extended trades.

boots.why: 75% of Darius players take Steelcaps here (48.3% WR, 721 games) over Mercury's Treads (54.7%, 190 games). Jax's damage comes almost entirely from autos, Relentless Assault stacks and Empowered Strike, so flat physical reduction blunts his main damage source even though the smaller sample favors Treads.

core.why: First item in both of the two highest-win-rate core paths (55.7% and 56.4%). The active haste closes the gap Jax opens with a Leap Strike reset and lets you land your E pull before he escapes.
Second item in every listed core path. The movement speed while walking helps you close onto a kiting Jax between engages, and the charged auto adds extra trade damage on top of Hemorrhage.
Completes the top-win-rate path (55.7% over 61 games). The damage-over-time conversion smooths out Jax's burst windows off Counter Strike and Empowered Strike so you survive to drop R.

runes.keystoneWhy: This page runs the best measured numbers here (50.5% WR, 20.2% pick) over the Conqueror page (46.5%, 19% pick). Casting three separate abilities in quick succession procs a bonus movement burst, letting you stick to Jax after he uses Leap Strike to disengage instead of watching him kite back to range.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the highest-win-rate spell pair measured here (50.9%, 22.3% pick). The execute race lets you close out short trades before Jax's level 6 Grandmaster's Might active buys him out of range. Flash+Ghost is still the most-picked option (49.2%, 65% pick) if you'd rather out-stick his Leap Strike resets than force kills.

playing.title: Bait Counter Strike first
playing.detail: Never open with your full Q-auto into W-auto combo. Throw a single unboosted auto or use E first so Jax burns his E dodge before you commit the stacking damage.

playing.title: Pull before you swing
playing.detail: Darius's E (Apprehend) reaches further than Jax needs to threaten a Leap Strike reset. Land it first so you guarantee an auto instead of walking into his stun.

playing.title: Punish a used Leap Strike
playing.detail: Once Jax dashes to a minion or ward to reposition, his only escape and engage tool is down for its full cooldown. Walk up and force the trade immediately.

playing.title: Track Hemorrhage to five stacks
playing.detail: Your passive's true damage spikes hard at max stacks. Hold R (Noxian Guillotine) for the stack-five window rather than throwing it early for the base damage.

playing.title: Shorten trades before level 6
playing.detail: Jax's early Counter Strike into free autos wins most extended exchanges. Cap yourself at two auto trades and disengage rather than fighting it out.

playing.title: Close range with Youmuu's active
playing.detail: Once Youmuu's Ghostblade is online, use the active haste to catch Jax mid-kite instead of chasing him at base movement speed.

playing.title: Boots blunt his damage source
playing.detail: Plated Steelcaps directly cuts the auto-attack damage from Relentless Assault stacks and Empowered Strike procs, which is most of what actually kills you here.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, summoner, and win-rate numbers are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the tactical reasoning behind trade sequencing and cooldown windows is my own read of the kits.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Jax’s Leap Strike (Q) – Counter Strike (E) by using [E]. Apply pressure when his (E) is on cooldown to gain lane control.
